locations.note: Time traveller Fay arrives in the ruins of San Francisco in 2050 to change the future.
Retired scientist Bent Svensson lives quietly in Norway's fjord country when Fay comes to find him.
Fay talks her way into the Energy Oslo conference as an inspector to warn the delegates about the Indez power plant and put Bent's algae fuel on the table.
The last chapters: Bent and Fay reach the Indez power plant in the Brazilian rainforest on the day it is due to explode and take the earth's climate with it.
